subject: Your MCP context cost post
text:
Hi,

Liked that your best MCP servers post actually measures what each one loads into context instead of just listing names. I run PickAPlugin, a free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins and MCP servers.

We put together some numbers on the Codex plugin side here: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026
Free to cite with a credit link if it's ever useful. And if you'd like Corsair listed on PickAPlugin, happy to add it for free.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your MCP context tax report
text:

subject: Your best ChatGPT plugins list
text:

subject: One more for your MCP directories list
text:
